sloka: सूताश्च संस्तवैर्दिव्यैर्बोधयन्ति स्म राघवम् ।स्तुतिभिः स्तूयमानाभिः प्रत्यबुध्यत राघवः ।। ७.३७.१० ॥
transliteration: sūtāśca saṁstavairdivyairbodhayanti sma rāghavam ।stutibhiḥ stūyamānābhiḥ pratyabudhyata rāghavaḥ ।। 7.37.10 ॥

translations.english: The bards, with their divine praises, awakened Rama, and Rama awoke to the sound of these eulogies being sung.
